description: Extends F1a with TES thermal losses, ambient T compressor correction, and cavern thermal drift. RTE recalibrated to 0.700 (w_exp=335 kJ/kg) to satisfy A-CAES physical limit <0.75.

unit.name: Generic A-CAES (ADELE-class) + Thermal
unit.source: Barbour et al. (2015) RE&SE Reviews 45:598; Budt et al. (2016) Applied Energy 170:250; Wolf & Budt (2014) Applied Energy 125:158; Zunft et al. (2006) DLR TR

k_comp_T.note: Specific work change per K above T_ref

T_tes_design.note: TES design charge temperature (multi-stage compression heat, 277°C)

T_tes_ambient.note: Ambient reference for TES heat loss

Cm_tes.note: TES thermal mass (concrete/rock bed, ~500 t at 2000 J/(kg·K))

UA_tes.note: TES insulation conductance; tau_tes = 1e9/5000 = 200000 s ≈ 56 h

k_tes_temp_coeff.note: Sensitivity of expansion work to TES temp deviation

physics_notes.rte_physical_limit: < 0.75 for A-CAES (Budt 2016); hard constraint enforced in tests
physics_notes.rte_cold_ambient: Increases slightly (less compression work) at T_amb < 288 K
